text_block_list.text:
"The Japanese Derby. A grand stage an 
Umamusume can only challenge once in her 
lifetime, during the Classic year."

The immense pressure of "the race to 
decide the best in Japan" bears heavily on 
my body. ...The cold tension threatens to 
choke me.

Even so, we have to face it. Because we're 
aiming to be the best in the world.

The Nippon Derby, and the future Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe. I will seize victory 
alongside <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...? Wasn't this girl, <chrname>, featured on a 
TV special before? Something before the 
Derby...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it that thing? Aiming for the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe! She was even racing 
against overseas contenders, you know~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! But back then, I didn't know any of 
those foreign Umamusume~ I don't really 
watch foreign races, so...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Either way, we'll see her true skill here. 
She's gotta show us if she has the 
strength to take on the world.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
(...Are you going to let the crowd judge 
for themselves on the grand stage of the 
Derby? Whether or not you are worthy of 
their cheers...)

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Ah... your determination really is 
something else. ...Good luck out there, <chrname>.
